scope: Offline replay of one previously captured official NASA Image of the Day RSS window; no new network request

checks.name: baseline drops all 60 supplied publication dates
candidate preserves all 60 exact XML-decoded pubDate values
all captured dates independently parse as GMT and match candidate UTC
all dates valid with known timezone
all other in-memory fields byte-value equal, including titles and manifest states
public receipts expose UTC/state but no raw pubDate
all unrelated public receipt fields unchanged

limits: Common RFC-style subset only; comments, nested markup and leap seconds remain raw unsupported values.
Unknown/missing zones produce no UTC instant. Explicit -0000 means UTC with unknown source timezone.
No runtime collector, UI date presentation, ordering, complete-history or playback acceptance.
No browser/CI assertion. Prior title PR remains required and unmerged.
retained_failures: Initial replay harness incorrectly required seconds; the actual feed uses HH:MM GMT. Corrected only the independent expected-value format, retained failure, and replayed identical captured bytes.
Independent review found Python Unicode IGNORECASE accepted long-s as ASCII S in named zones. Added ASCII regex flag and regression before publication.
Initial source index sort moved the baseline register after fragments. Restored required baseline-first ordering; final source loader and tests pass.
